settings.heading: Cooling Dog Beds
settings.subhead: Comfort that holds up when the temperature does not.
settings.intro:
British summers are short, but they are not gentle, and a dog carrying a double coat feels every degree. The Cooling Collection is built around materials that move heat away from your dog instead of trapping it: pressure-activated gel, open mesh, and raised frames that let air pass underneath. No freezing, no plugs, no batteries.

Every bed here comes with our 100-night trial and free UK delivery over £40.

settings.title: Pressure-activated gel
settings.text: The gel responds to your dog's body weight and contact, drawing warmth away from the surface. It recharges itself once nothing is lying on it. Nothing to freeze, nothing to plug in.

settings.title: Airflow, not insulation
settings.text: Standard beds hold heat between your dog and the floor. Elevated mesh frames and open-weave panels let air move through and underneath, so warmth has somewhere to go.

settings.heading: The questions we get asked most.

settings.question: Do I need to freeze or refrigerate these?
settings.answer: No. The gel mats work on contact and pressure, and the elevated beds work on airflow. Nothing goes in the freezer and nothing needs charging.

settings.question: How long does the cooling effect last?
settings.answer: A gel mat runs for around three hours per cycle, then recharges itself once your dog gets off it. Elevated mesh beds work continuously – there is no cycle and no recharge.

settings.question: Can I put a cooling mat on top of a bed my dog already loves?
settings.answer: Yes, and it is the easiest way to introduce one. Dogs settle faster on a familiar bed with a new surface than on a completely new bed.

settings.question: Will my dog chew it?
settings.answer: Gel mats are not chew-proof. If your dog is a determined chewer, choose an elevated frame instead, and supervise the first few sessions with any new bed.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Gel mats wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Removable covers machine wash at 30°C. Air dry – do not tumble dry.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer: Measure your dog nose to tail base while they are lying stretched out, then add 15cm. If they are between two sizes, size up.

settings.question: Will a cooling bed keep my dog safe in hot weather?
settings.answer: It keeps the surface they lie on cooler than the floor, and that is the honest limit of it. It is not a substitute for shade, fresh water, or keeping a dog out of a hot car. If you are worried about your dog in the heat, speak to your vet.
